title: MadeArtist
description: MUSIC-LISTEN-C5. A band or artist the household made here: name, back story, members, portrait and logo, and the `style` every track of the band reuses so an album sounds like one band. Only what a media-item cannot hold gets this record: a track is a normal made song whose `artist` text is the band's name, and an album is a media-collection, so there is no album record here. Person scope, always labelled 'Made here'. Fictional by default (the creator's prompt asks for a fictional band and fictional people); that is a default, not a block for an adult. Names, back story and member names are a person's words and are never logged (rule 6a). A band made 'like' a playing track keeps that track as its `seed`; the new band's own name, members, back story and lyrics are never a copy of it.

name.description: The band's name, as shown and as written on each track's artist field. Trimmed; not unique.

origin.description: Always made: a band found in the library is a media-item artist, not this record.

backstory.description: Plain text, never HTML. Passes the same output gate as chat before it is stored (rule 10).

genres.description: Genre words for the band's page and for browsing.

source.description: hub: authoritative on the hub. local: made on a robot, not yet synced.

provenance.description: Free text naming who made the band, for example 'person-a1b2c3 (self)'.

deleted_at.description: Set when the band is deleted, so a syncing client drops it. Its tracks stay as songs.
